purpose: Frozen, prompt-independent case set for the (catalyst event, candidate ticker) role instrument. The golden replay cassette for the map-themes stage is keyed on the prompt SHA and re-records whenever the prompt changes, so it cannot measure a prompt change. These cases are fixed payloads taken from recorded runs and stay valid across issue #975 (mapper prompt) and issue #976 (article-to-event-set rework).

excluded_fields.why: The instrument is blind to the pipeline's own verdict by design. Freezing those fields into the fixture would let them leak back into a prompt and turn the measurement into a self-consistency check.

sources.name: role_audit_input.parquet
sources.description: 450-row joined brief-row x catalyst-event corpus the role instrument was first run over. Supplies all six anchor payloads. Ad-hoc join: no script in the repo produces it and the file was not kept, so unlike the two production caches below it cannot be re-read to re-check these payloads - the copies frozen here are the surviving record. New cases should come from a source that can be read again.

cases.contested_reason: The strict and permissive rubrics disagree on this class by construction. NVIDIA's Ising release names NVDA only; QUBT reaches it as a sector-level quantum tailwind. The permissive rubric counts a sector-level channel, the strict rubric explicitly does not ('a general sector tailwind is NOT a channel'). Neither reading is wrong, so this case is TRACKED to watch the instrument's spread and DOES NOT gate any run.
